D5/S0/Diagonal/RecursivePageTable.recurs.name: D5.S0.Diagonal.RecursivePageTable.recursive_page_table_walk
D5/S0/Diagonal/RecursivePageTable.recurs.signature: theorem recursive_page_table_walk (lookup : Address -> Fin N -> Address) (root leaf data : Address) (selfSlot i j : Fin N) (hself : lookup root selfSlot = root) (hroot : lookup root i = leaf) (hleaf : lookup leaf j = data) : pageWalk lookup root [i, j] = data /\ pageWalk lookup root [selfSlot, i] = leaf /\ forall depth : Nat, pageWalk lookup root (List.replicate depth selfSlot) = root
